builds_on: crypto PR #5291 (arm D2, b2lp-20261127/v1, head 73bf5f4e) and PR #5290 (arm D-S, bdsl-20261127/v1, head 92f096c1), both on #5261 / #5253
single_target: every solve is one cold solve of one public Q; no multi-target amortisation (owner instruction)
seed_derivation: unchanged #5253 seeds.rs: seed(parts) = first 8 bytes big-endian of SHA-256('bcr-20261126/v1|' + '|'.join(parts)); stream = SplitMix64(seed). Curves, targets and A1 streams are bitwise those of #5253/#5261/#5290/#5291.
custody: d drawn from the 'target' stream inside the evaluator; solvers receive (curve, G, Q, ell); [d]G = Q checked inside the counted solve; d == d_true compared after the solve

D2S.rule: fs = min(F-1, ceil(theta*F^beta)); (beta, theta) from the part A pilot rule (raw OLS beta 0.359 clamped to 0.5, theta refitted)

D2S23.rule: beta = 2/3 (textbook k = 3 2LP balance), theta = gmean of the pilot's fs*/F^(2/3)

D2Sall.rule: every class small on #5290's LA stream: must reproduce D-S bitwise (d, targets, relations, LA phase counters, la_report, LA calls)

la: #5290 sparse_la.rs unchanged: SGE (kmax 64, cost-model stop) + scalar Wiedemann (4 attempts, |u| = 16, excess <= 2); #5290 stopping rule on Y_ub and fs (start 0.70 fs, step ceil(fs/256))
forest: BFS rebuilt at every checkpoint (from SV, else the union-find root), deepest-first cycle reduction, empty combinations dropped (amendment A1)

references.DS: #5290 data/runs_ds.jsonl, arm DS (n = 18..54; 12 cases at n = 51, 4 at n = 54)
references.D2: #5291 data/runs_d2.jsonl, arm D2 (n = 18..54; 4 cases at n = 51, 2 at n = 54)
references.RHO: 16 seeds per target: #5253 runs.jsonl (n <= 33), #5261 runs_ext_ref.jsonl (36..48), n = 51 W = 128 (#5291 runs_ext_rho.jsonl 4 cases + this study 8 cases), n = 54 W = 64 (#5290 runs_rho_new.jsonl, 4 cases), n = 57 W = 256 and n = 60 (this study)

resources.rule: a killed/failed process is a resource-limit record, never a negative result; the run continues with the next rung

primary_metric: Meq(s=1,u=1) of the whole cold solve (fb, setup, targets, oracle, resolve, graph, LA, verify); #5253 unit
band: u in {0, 0.1, 1} for non-field units, s in {1, 0.25}; orders stated only where they hold across the band (AGENTS.md 5a); +/-1 products and LA bookkeeping charged as sensitivities

checks.logs: [d]G = Q in-solve and d == d_true for every record; D2S/D2S23 d equal to DS's and D2's d on shared cases
checks.rows: every row fed to every LA call checked by the group law sum e_c [h]P_c = [a][h]G + [b][h]Q (uncounted)
checks.yield_identity: at every checkpoint: BFS yields + empty_dropped = #5291 LpGraph yields on the same relations (uncounted shadow)
checks.kernel: n <= 30: the sparse dependency traced back to the input rows satisfies sum c_j row_j = 0 and gives d (#5290 track check), and #5253's echelon on the same rows gives the same d
checks.replay: n = 30, ci = 0, ti = 0, arm D2S rerun from the frozen manifest; all fields but wall times compared

falsifier: parity at a rung if the upper 95% bound of D2S/rho (or D2S23/rho) <= 1 there
exclusions: none; every record, failure, kill and mismatch is retained
